decisions.title: Reject process-wide mutable cache for plugin discovery
decisions.summary: Process-wide cache rejected due to tenant data leakage risk between interpreters.
decisions.reasoning: Maintainer explicitly agreed to reject the proposal citing tenant isolation concerns and proposed an alternative interpreter-local cache with explicit invalidation.

alternatives.label: interpreter-local cache with explicit invalidation
alternatives.reason: Proposed by reviewer and confirmed by maintainer as the replacement strategy.

evidence.excerpt: I reject the process-wide mutable cache because it leaks tenant data between independent interpreters. Consider an interpreter-local cache instead.
Agreed: reject the process-wide cache due to tenant isolation. We will use an interpreter-local cache, with explicit invalidation on plugin reload.
